Context: 3. Date of Birth and its subsequent alteration

3. Subsequent alteration of Date of Birth.An alteration of date of birth can be made, with the sanction of a Ministry/ Department or the C. & A.G. in the case of IAAD or an Administrator of a Union Territory, if-
- an employee makes a request in this regard within five years of
- (a) his entry into Government service;
- it is clearly established that a genuine bona fide mistake had
- (b) occurred; and
